title: vaccinium miniatum
intro: Vaccinium miniatum, commonly known as the Dwarf Blue Huckleberry, is a type of shrub native to North America. This plant is known for its edible blue berries, which are rich in nutrients and provide several health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Vaccinium miniatum include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
